The '''Snowstone Turning''' was an area located in the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Snowstone Turning appears as an area on Hoth in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
